property_summary: The function transfer must always return true upon successful completion; the bug returns false, violating the invariant that a non-reverting call returns true.
For any non-reverting call to transfer, the return value must be true; the bug always returns false on success, violating this invariant.
For any admissible input that does not revert, the transfer function must return true. The buggy version violates this by returning false even when all sub-calls succeed.

Reference C performs external calls using the transferFrom(address,address,uint256) selector, while the mutant incorrectly uses transfer(address,uint256), causing the overall call to succeed on a callee that implements transferFrom but not transfer, whereas the mutant fails.
The reference contract always reverts with an empty _tos array; the mutant succeeds without revert.
The total balance of all recipients after transfer must equal the sum of all sent amounts; the buggy version sends 0 instead of v, causing the sum to be zero while the reference sends v to each.
After a successful call to transfer(caddress) from a non-zero address, the external call to caddress should have been made with value v; the buggy version passes 0
